Log Entry 001 Mission Year 7, Day 203

The Silence Between Stars

It has been 214 days since I last heard a human voice that wasn't a recording. Tonight the ship's passive arrays picked up something at 1,420 MHz — hydrogen line. Natural, almost certainly. And yet my hands wouldn't stop shaking as I ran the analysis...

Log Entry 002 Mission Year 7, Day 251

A Planet No One Named

The catalog designation is GJ 1061 d. I've started calling her Cinder. She hangs in the viewport like a burnt ember — tidally locked, one hemisphere forever scorched, the other plunged in perpetual dark. In the terminator band between them, I spotted something that stopped my breath...
